Moeve S A obligations are up 108.0% year over year. The current-year total is the largest single-year figure reported in the available sequence. The award count and average award size indicate a mix of mid- to large-value contracts. That change suggests increased activity or larger contract awards in the current fiscal year, while prior years show a peak in FY23 at $215M before a dip in FY24 and FY25.
